changes.text: Header and body cells render `data-align="start" | "end" | "center"` (was `left` / `right`), and numeric columns default to `end`. `TableColumn.align` accepts `start` / `end` and still takes `left` / `right`, which map to them; plain-HTML markup with `data-align="right"` keeps working.
The sort button shows the solid `--ss-primary` focus ring (was a `--ss-primary-soft` glow at about 1.5:1).
Caption, header and cell alignment use logical `text-align: start` / `end`, so columns mirror under `dir="rtl"`.
The legacy global `.ss-table` layout class in `theme.css`, which shared its name with this component's root, is removed. Use `<Table>`, or in plain HTML its markup with `dssoca/vanilla.css`.
Plain-HTML styling: `dssoca/vanilla.css` styles the same markup the Svelte component renders. Load it after `theme.css`.
The older global `.ss-table` layout class in `theme.css`, which shares its name with this component's root, is deprecated and will be removed in 0.18.0.

New component: a semantic data table driven by typed `columns` (`align`, `numeric`, `format`, `cell` snippet) and `rows`, with client-side sortable headers (`aria-sort`, bindable `sort`, `onsort`), an `empty` snippet, `caption`, `getRowKey` and `size`. Exports the `TableColumn` and `TableSort` types.
